description: This file defines the UriInterface interface as specified in PSR-7, representing a URI with methods to access and modify its components, primarily used in HTTP messaging context.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the scheme component of the URI, normalized to lowercase, or an empty string if none is present.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Retrieves the authority component of the URI in '[user-info@]host[:port]' format, or empty if not present.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the user information component, including username and optional password, or empty if not present.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Retrieves the host component, normalized to lowercase, or empty if not present.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port component as an integer if non-standard, or null if default or not set.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path component of the URI, percent-encoded.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the query string component, percent-encoded.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified scheme, supporting 'http' and 'https'.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified user info, including optional password.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified port or null if removing.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified fragment.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the full URI, assembled from components.
